Mew package executable runner. Executes local or temporary package binaries. (v0.0.0-test+deadbee)

Usage: mx <command> [...flags] [...args]

Cache and artifacts
  cache:          Manage mx execution cache

Configuration and tooling
  version:        Print version information
  completion:     Generate shell completion scripts

Flags:
      --accessible           accessible append-only output
      --ascii                use ASCII instead of Unicode symbols
      --config string        JSONC config file overlay path
      --cwd string           project working directory
      --debug                verbose diagnostics (env MEW_DEBUG or M_LOG=debug)
      --filter stringArray   workspace package filter (pnpm-style)
  -h, --help                 help for Mew
      --log-level string     log level: error | warn | info | debug
      --no-color             disable ANSI color
      --no-progress          disable progress output
      --no-summary           suppress command summary output
      --offline              force offline mode
      --output string        output mode: rich | plain | json | ndjson | silent
      --prefer-offline       prefer cached artifacts
  -v, --version              version for Mew

Use "mx [command] --help" for more information about a command.
Use "mx help <topic>" for curated topics (errors, runner, lifecycle-trust, …).
